detail.description:
Located in the heart of New Delhi, Le Meridien offers luxurious accommodations within a short drive of Jantar Mantar and Vigyan Bhavan. This Art Deco hotel features an outdoor pool, a spa with massages and body treatments, and a fitness center. Each of the 358 individually decorated guestrooms offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, minibars, and LCD televisions with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include deep soaking bathtubs and designer toiletries. Guests can dine at the on-site restaurant, enjoy 24-hour room service, or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and extensive meeting and conference space.
